name: From Study to Hired: CV, Interviews and the First 90 Days
summary: The part that comes after the last course: a CV that gets read, a profile that gets found, an interview that holds no surprises, and the first ninety days nobody explains.
prerequisites: No prerequisite beyond having something to show, which the portfolio project produces. The course is the same whichever track you came from — the market changes less often than the technology does.
